description: Emails the person a link to watch these CSLB licenses: once they open it, they get one short email on any day something changes on one (status, workers' comp, bonds, classes, expiry). Nothing is watched until the person opens the link. Use the person's own email, only when they asked. Free watches 25 licenses, Pro up to 500 for $99 a year, Unlimited every license they add for $999 a year. Not for decisions about a person's credit, employment, insurance or housing.

licenses.description: CSLB license numbers or listing links, up to 500.
